Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National NDC clears 46 Aspirants to vie for various regional positions in Bono East Source : GNA 22 October 2026 5:07am Audio By Carbonatix
The Bono East Regional office of the National Democratic Congress has successfully vetted 46 aspirants, clearing them to vie for the various regional positions in the party.
Mr Isaac Adepsah, the Bono East Regional Secretary of the NDC told the Ghana News Agency (GNA) in an interview that the party remained dedicated to facilitating free, fair and credible elections in the region.
He advised the aspirants contesting in 16 regional positions and their followers to remain decorous in their political campaigns and activities, asking them to concentrate on issue-based campaigns.
Mr Adepsah said a five-member vetting committee conducted the exercise, including three national executives of the party.
He commended Mr Francis Owusu Antwi, the Bono East Regional Minister, for his continued support to the party activities in the region.
In a separate interview, Mr Nuru Hamidan, the Deputy Chief Executive Officer of the State Transport Corporation (STC) and leader of the vetting committee, commended the aspirants for their comportment.
He called on them to remain peaceful in the conduct of their political campaigns, urging them to accept the outcome of the regional elections wholeheartedly to deepen the prevailing peace and unity of the party in the region.
